name: The noun
definition: A word that shows a meaning in itself without tying it to a time: a person, a thing or a quality.
body: Nouns name: رَجُلٌ (a man), كِتَابٌ (a book), عِلْمٌ (knowledge), زَيْدٌ (Zayd). Unlike a verb, a noun carries no tense.

Al-Ājurrūmiyya gives the noun four signs: the kasra of khafḍ, tanwīn, the article al-, and the particles of khafḍ before it, as in فِي البَيْتِ (in the house). A word that takes one of them is a noun.

examples.text: al-kitābu, the book: the article al- marks a noun.
kitābun, a book: tanwīn marks a noun.
